Sherpa's Linux SecureStorage implementation is adapted from Redth/Plugins.Maui:
https://github.com/Redth/Plugins.Maui/pull/1
Revision: 5a9d5c40eea12027dfae6a60cfb795441a7ece42

The libsecret storage approach and versioned schema originated in dotnet/maui-labs:
https://github.com/dotnet/maui-labs/tree/435cd7a1ca6d0a1fde9cf10f445612d635688d3b/platforms/Linux.Gtk4
